description: This file defines the UserService class responsible for managing user entities, including creating, updating, retrieving, listing, and deleting users, with role assignment functionality.

classes.name: UserService
classes.description: Service class for user management operations and role assignments.

methods.name: Optional[User] get(self, user_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieve a user by user ID.

methods.name: list(self, page: int, per_page: int)
methods.description: Retrieve a paginated list of users along with total count.

methods.name: User create(self, email: str, full_name: str, password: str, roles: _Optional[List[str]] = None)
methods.description: Create a new user with specified email, full name, password, and roles.

methods.name: User update( self, user: User, full_name: _Optional[str] = None, password: _Optional[str] = None, is_active: _Optional[bool] = None, roles: _Optional[List[str]] = None, )
methods.description: Update user attributes including full name, password, activation status, and roles.
